summary: The substantive deliverable, ai-os/audits/projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit_2026-07-27.md, is solid: I independently spot-checked its file/line/function claims against the real current repo state (schema.ts parentLineItemId/breakdownPercentage, construction-boq-service.ts's computeHierarchicalAmount/diffLineItems, construction-valuation-service.ts's generateInterimBill/buildInterimBillInvoiceItems with required taxTemplateId, erp-invoicing-service.ts's computeInvoiceTaxTotals, and construction-reports-service.ts's roster/orgWide/projectScoped fix) and every claim matched real code, not fabrication. The ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml addition is a clean, well-formed append with no conflicts. However, the PROGRESS.md change in this same diff is a real defect: commit 031584cd is titled 'restore prior tasks' progress notes, append this task's section' but instead it truncates an in-progress sentence about a bug fix mid-clause and replaces the rest of that entry plus four entire subsequent historical task sections (task-20260727-132826 PR#597 budget-undercount fix, task-20260727-100954 HR gaps, task-20260727-101123 PM gaps, task-20260727-093117 sharp-CVE/BoQ corrective fix) with the literal placeholder text '... more files changed' -- garbage that looks like a leaked diff-stat truncation artifact rather than real content, permanently destroying governance-relevant historical record for unrelated already-merged work. This directly contradicts the commit's own stated intent and AGENTS.md Rule 16's traceability requirement, and is exactly the kind of self-report-vs-actual-diff mismatch this review process exists to catch. No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff. Reject and send back for a trivial fix: restore the real truncated PROGRESS.md content (or at minimum remove the garbage placeholder line) before re-submitting; the audit report and claims-registry content can be kept as-is.
issues: PROGRESS.md line 112 contains the literal garbage string '... more files changed' (committed in 031584cd), which truncates an in-progress sentence and silently deletes 4 entire historical PROGRESS.md sections for unrelated, already-merged tasks (task-20260727-132826, task-20260727-100954, task-20260727-101123, task-20260727-093117's corrective-fix section) despite the commit message claiming to 'restore prior tasks' progress notes'. This is real information loss in a governance/record-keeping document, not a benign reformat.
